Currency.name: World currency
Currency.label: Configure currency
Currency.hint: Define the denominations and conversion rates of this world's currency.

Setup.name: Setup check
Setup.label: Open setup assistant
Setup.hint: Checks whether the Daggerheart system and the store are configured for this module and fixes it on request.

StartupCheck.name: Check setup on start
StartupCheck.hint: Opens the setup assistant for the GM when a problem is found.

Config.title: Campaign Currency
Config.intro: Each character's wealth is stored as a single amount in the smallest denomination. The denominations below only define how that amount is split up and displayed.
Config.name: Currency name
Config.nameHint: Shown wherever the currency as a whole is meant, e.g. "Crowns".
Config.applyPresetConfirm: Replace all denominations with the selected preset? Unsaved changes are lost.
Config.label: Name
Config.factorHint: Exactly one denomination must have the value 1 (the base unit). Values must be unique whole numbers.
Config.ruleHandfulHint: Daggerheart prices are given in handfuls (e.g. in the store's price list). This value converts them into your currency and sets the store's price multiplier. Typical: about the value of a meal and a night at an inn.

Errors.NoDenominations: The currency needs at least one denomination.
Errors.TooManyDenominations: A currency can have at most {max} denominations.
Errors.NoBaseDenomination: Exactly one denomination must have the value 1 (base unit).
Errors.DuplicateFactor: Two denominations have the same value.
Errors.DuplicateId: Two denominations have the same id.
Errors.MarkupCharacters: Denomination and currency names must not contain < or >.

Wallet.dragHint: Drag onto another character or the party sheet to hand over money (amount in base units).
Wallet.inputHint: Enter a number, or +n / -n to add or remove. Missing amounts are changed from higher denominations automatically.
Wallet.invalidInput: Please enter a whole number, optionally with + or -.

Setup.title: Campaign Currency – Setup
Setup.intro: This module needs a few settings in the Daggerheart system and the Daggerheart Store. Fixes change those settings directly.
Setup.startupCheck: Open this assistant on start when a problem is found

coinsEnabled.title: "Coins" enabled in the system
coinsEnabled.detail: The system hides the whole currency block when "Coins" is disabled in its homebrew settings.

legacyWealth.title: No money left in handfuls, bags or chests
legacyWealth.detail: {count} actor(s) still hold money in the old tiers, which this module does not show: {names}. "Fix" opens the migration.

legacyTiersDisabled.title: Handfuls, bags and chests disabled in the system
legacyTiersDisabled.detail: These tiers are not used by this module and should be disabled.
legacyTiersDisabled.blocked: Can only be disabled once nobody holds money in them any more (migrate first, see above).

labelsSynced.title: System names match the world currency
labelsSynced.detail: The system's currency name, coin label and icon are used e.g. in the transfer dialog and by the store and should match the base denomination.

storeMode.title: Store currency mode "Disabled"
storeMode.detail: In any other mode the store converts money with fixed rates (1/10/100/1000) and bypasses the world currency.

storePriceScale.title: Store prices match the price scale
storePriceScale.detail: The store's price multiplier is {actual} %, the price scale of the world currency needs {expected} %. Prices you set manually per item are not changed.

storeVersion.title: Store shows prices in your denominations
storeVersion.detail: Daggerheart: Store {version} shows prices in the base unit only. Update it to {minimum} or newer to see e.g. "1 Gold 2 Silver".

Migration.title: Migrate old currency
Migration.intro: Converts money held in handfuls, bags and chests into the world currency. The previous values are kept as a backup on each actor.
Migration.coinHint: Only set the coin value to something other than 1 if the coin field still holds rule coins, i.e. before anyone used the new wallet.
Migration.invalidRates: All values must be whole numbers of at least 1.
Migration.nothingToDo: No actor needs to be migrated.
Migration.disableLegacyTiers: Then disable handfuls, bags and chests in the system
Migration.confirm: Migrate the money of {count} actor(s)? A backup of the previous values is stored on each actor.
